description: Aglomeracije za odvajanje in čiščenje komunalne odpadne vode - 2019 is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. The list of agglomerations 2019 has been updated in accordance with the Decree on agglomerations in the field of discharges and treatment of urban waste water (UL RS No 113/25). In the full range of agglomerations (50 p.e. Coverage: AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. The portal shows the English title as "Agglomerations for the discharge and treatment of urban waste water - 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. Its keywords include območje poselitve, odvajanje komunalne odpadne vode, obremenitev, čiščenje komunalne odpadne vode, Komunalne in javne storitve, aglomeracija. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
